title: No Equivariant Architecture Covers All Equivariant Attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.30417v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We give a complete characterization of equivariant multi-head self-attention (MHSA): if an MHSA layer is equivariant to a symmetry group $G$, then $G$ can only act by permuting head-clusters, with QK and OV matrices satisfying an equivariance constraint tied to the group action. As a consequence, we prove that any fixed MHSA architecture that achieves exact equivariance by polynomially parameterizing unconstrained MHSA parameters inevitably leads to expressivity loss within the class of equivariant maps: the equivariance locus of unconstrained MHSA forms a union of extremely many Zariski-irreducible components in a reduced parameter space, and any single architecture covers at most one. For $G=D_4$ acting on $C$ copies of the regular representation as the token feature space, we show that there are $\Omega(C^{64})$ components for eight attention heads.

translated_title: 没有任何等变架构能覆盖所有等变注意力
translated_abstract: 我们对等变多头自注意力给出了完整的刻画：若一个MHSA层对某个对称群 $G$ 是等变的，则 $G$ 只能通过置换头簇来作用，且QK矩阵和OV矩阵必须满足与该群作用相关联的等变性约束。由此我们证明，任何通过多项式参数化无约束MHSA参数来实现精确等变性的固定MHSA架构，都不可避免地在等变映射类中造成表达能力损失：无约束MHSA的等变性轨迹在约化参数空间中形成由极多个Zariski不可约分支构成的并集，而任何单一架构至多只能覆盖其中一个分支。对于 $G=D_4$ 作用于正则表示的 $C$ 个副本作为词元特征空间的情形，我们证明在八个注意力头下存在 $\Omega(C^{64})$ 个分支。
tldr: 本文完整刻画了等变多头自注意力的结构，并证明其等变性轨迹分裂为极多个不可约分支，因此任何固定的等变注意力架构至多覆盖其中一个分支，必然损失对等变映射的表达能力。
en_tdlr: This paper gives a complete characterization of equivariant multi-head self-attention and proves that its equivariance locus decomposes into extremely many irreducible components, so any fixed equivariant architecture covers at most one component and inevitably loses expressivity for equivariant maps.
